# Unnati Ispat

> Steel traders and distributors in Dombivli East, Thane district (Mumbai region), Maharashtra, India, since 2000. Supplies TMT bars, structural steel, plates, sheets, coils, hollow sections, pipes, wires and hardware to construction, fabrication and infrastructure buyers.

- Address: Unit 405, Globe Arcade, Plot No. RP-112, Nr. Ganesh Temple, MIDC Residential Area, Dombivli East, Maharashtra 421203, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91525 35156
- Email: info@unnatiispat.com
- Areas served: Dombivli, Kalyan, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Mumbai and the rest of Maharashtra
